title: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning
meta: Michiel Schreurs, et al. · Nature Communications · 2024

title: From Data to Draught: Modelling and Predicting Mixed-Culture Beer Fermentation Dynamics Using Autoregressive Recurrent Neural Networks

title: Predictive modeling using artificial intelligence for sensory panel assessments of customized beer production

title: Predicting acetic acid content in the final beer using neural networks and support vector machine

title: Learning algorithms for identification of whisky using portable Raman spectroscopy

title: Quick insights into whisky: investigating rapid and efficient methods for sensory evaluation and chemical analysis

title: Recent advances in whiskey analysis for authentication, discrimination, and quality control

title: Machine learning-based predictive modelling for the enhancement of wine quality

title: Wine feature importance and quality prediction: A comparative study of machine learning algorithms with unbalanced data

title: Wine Quality Prediction with Ensemble Trees: A Unified, Leak-Free Comparative Study

title: End-to-end deep learning for directly estimating grape yield from ground-based imagery
meta: et al. · Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (arXiv preprint) · 2022

title: Grape detection, segmentation and tracking using deep neural networks and three-dimensional association
meta: Santos, et al. · arXiv (later Computers and Electronics in Agriculture) · 2019

meta: Claudia Gonzalez Viejo, Sigfredo Fuentes · Sensors · 2022
